title: Variance-aware signed circuit cutting
difficulty_explanation: The solution must combine signed fragment reconstruction, TensorCircuit boundary-state experiments, derivative-aware integer shot allocation, and canonical seeded sampling.

contract.anti_hardcoding: The seed changes both fragments, observables, shot budgets, and sampling streams; oracle values are not passed to the solution.
contract.oracle: Independent complex128 NumPy fragments plus an uncut statevector identity canary

difficulty_levers: boundary state can be entangled with discarded left qubits
seeded finite-shot sampling in a canonical component order
claim_boundary: The expert and evaluator are validated prototypes. No solver-model trial has been run and no model-hardness claim is made.
api_risks: expectation_ps uses integer Pauli codes 0=I, 1=X, 2=Y, 3=Z; a convention drift silently changes observables.
TensorCircuit backend and dtype configuration is process-global.
The prescribed seeded sampler relies on NumPy Generator/PCG64 and must be version-canary tested if the image changes.
